pr_title: [Refactor][Distributed] Remove all_to_all patch and switch lm-head TP to all_to_all_single
source_quote:
### Critical Divisibility Issue in Speculative Decoding with LM-Head TP
> The new `lmhead_all_to_all` helper uses `all_to_all_single` with a static `view(world_size, -1, vocab_per_partition)` reshape, which strictly requires the number of tokens `N` (i.e., `logits.shape[0]`) to be divisible by `world_size`.
> However, in `_run_merged_draft`, `logits` is computed from `sample_hidden_states`, which is indexed by `token_indices_to_sample`. When `lmhead_tp_enable()` is True, `token_indices_to_sample` is padded to `max_num_reqs_across_dp`:
> ```python
max_num_reqs_across_dp = (
self.vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * self.runner.uniform_decode_query_len
)
> If `max_num_reqs_across_dp` is not divisible by `world_size` (for example, if `max_num_seqs = 1` and `uniform_decode_query_len = 1` with `world_size = 2`), `logits.shape[0]` will not be divisible by `world_size`, causing a `RuntimeError` inside `lmhead_all_to_all`.
> To prevent this, we must ensure that `max_num_reqs_across_dp` is always padded to a multiple of `world_size` of the LM-head TP group.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha c66a110 体现修改

rule.description: 当某个通信原语（如 `lmhead_all_to_all` 内的 `view(world_size, -1, V/P)` + `dist.all_to_all_single`）要求 dim 0 size `N` 整除 `world_size` 时，所有决定 `N` 的上游量（如 `max_num_reqs_across_dp`）都必须 round-up 到 `world_size` 的倍数。需要全局排查所有消费点（如不同 proposer 的 `_run_merged_draft`），不能只改一个位置；同时保留原语内部的前置校验作为二级防线。
checkpoints: 识别整除性约束原语（`view(world_size, -1, ...)`、`all_to_all_single`、`tensor_split` 替换为 `view` 等）
反向追踪 dim 0 size 的所有上游决定量（如 `max_num_reqs_across_dp = max_num_seqs * uniform_decode_query_len`）
在每个决定量计算点加入 round-up：`x = ((x + tp_size - 1) // tp_size) * tp_size`
全局搜索同一通信原语的所有调用方（如 `llm_base_proposer.py` 两处 + `step3p5.py` 一处），对称修改，避免遗漏
区分"需要 padding 的路径"（如 spec_decode 从 per-rank `sample_hidden_states` 计算 logits）与"无需 padding 的路径"（如 `_get_logits_lmheadtp` 输入来自 `all_gather`，N 已是 P 倍数）
保留原语内部 `raise ValueError` 作为二级防线（防止未来新调用方忘记 padding）
优先用 `enable_reduce_sample` 等开关门控 padding，避免对未启用该路径的场景产生副作用

pattern.code:
def _run_merged_draft(self, ...):
    # ... 省略前置逻辑 ...
    if lmhead_tp_enable():
        max_num_reqs_across_dp = (
            self.vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
            * self.runner.uniform_decode_query_len
        )
        if get_ascend_config().enable_reduce_sample:
            tp_size = get_lmhead_tp_group().world_size
            # Round up to a multiple of tp_size so lmhead_all_to_all's
            # view(world_size, -1, V/P) reshape cannot fail on unequal split.
            max_num_reqs_across_dp = (
                (max_num_reqs_across_dp + tp_size - 1) // tp_size
            ) * tp_size
        token_indices_to_sample = torch.arange(max_num_reqs_across_dp, ...)
        sample_hidden_states = hidden_states[token_indices_to_sample]
        logits = self._compute_logits(sample_hidden_states)
        # logits.shape[0] 现在是 tp_size 的倍数，lmhead_all_to_all 安全
